# BC Road Safety Explorer

Interactive road safety analytics portfolio project by Utsav Patel.

## Pages
- Dashboard: https://utsav7123.github.io/bc-road-safety-explorer/
- Methodology: https://utsav7123.github.io/bc-road-safety-explorer/methodology/
- Source code: https://github.com/utsav7123/bc-road-safety-explorer

## Purpose
The project uses public aggregate RoadSafetyBC datasets to demonstrate KPI development, data cleaning, trend analysis, vulnerable road-user reporting, regional geospatial visualization, and transparent baseline forecasting.

## Important limitation
Map positions are regional visualization anchors, not individual crash locations. Forecast values are portfolio baseline projections and are not official ICBC or RoadSafetyBC forecasts.
